composites.name: growth-division
composites.description: Study 4 — growth & division: one individual becomes a heterogeneous population. The precarious individual grows as its (abstracted) autopoietic loop runs and, past a size threshold, DIVIDES into two daughters. The membrane is partitioned with noise so daughters differ; a heritable trait is inherited with mutation so lineages DIVERSIFY over generations. Division is precarious — a daughter that inherits too little membrane to maintain itself dissolves. Starve it (``supply=0``) and the lineage collapses: the no-self-maintenance control.

composites.name: membrane-metabolism-loop
composites.description: The minimal membrane/metabolism co-construction loop — a precarious, self-bounding identity that emerges from the molecular domain. Metabolism makes lipids; the membrane grows by incorporating them and decays without them; the volume is DERIVED from the membrane (the boundary emerges, never declared) and couples back into the concentration the bimolecular lipid step runs on. Supply (rate=0 starves) is the only boundary inflow.

composites.name: adaptive-chemotaxis
composites.description: Study 3 — adaptive chemotaxis: where life becomes mind. A population of run-and-tumble agents in a nutrient gradient senses the local food and tumbles less when nutrient is rising (bacterial chemotaxis); nutrient sustains the viability that keeps each agent alive. A chemotactic agent climbs the gradient, finds food, and survives; a blind agent (``chemotactic=false``) random-walks, starves, and dissolves. The gradient is MEANINGFUL from the perspective of the precarious identity — sense-making, agency in service of self-maintenance.

composites.name: spatial-containment
composites.description: Study 2 — the autopoiesis of containment on a 1-D lattice. Interior content DIFFUSES and would ddisperse into the medium; the self-produced membrane GATES the cross-boundary flux (permeability falls as the membrane grows), so the individual is held together against diffusion. The membrane is built by the metabolism it contains, and decays when starved — containment is precarious, the spatial edition. ``membrane_on=false`` is the discriminating no-membrane negative control; ``fed=false`` starves it.

studies.name: study-1-membrane-metabolism-loop
studies.description:
Assemble the smallest precarious, self-bounding identity by composing a toy metabolism,
a membrane that grows from its own lipids (and decays without them), and a boundary whose
volume is DERIVED from the membrane — then verify, with the autopoiesis meter, that the
network is operationally closed (modulo nutrient) and that the identity is precarious:
fed it persists, starved it dissipates.

studies.name: study-5-adversarial-probes
studies.description:
Turn the demonstration into a test: challenge the autopoiesis framework with
systems that should NOT qualify, and check that the metric REJECTS them. Two
probes — an externally-maintained mimic (persistence supplied from outside, not
self-produced) and a network missing a self-production step (no membrane
producer). The study passes only if the metric rejects both, showing the
criteria discriminate genuine self-production from superficial similarity.

studies.name: study-2-spatial-containment
studies.description:
Study 1 had no space — "inside" was a scalar volume. In a medium the self-produced
interior would diffuse away and the individual would dissolve. Put the cell on a 1-D
lattice where interior content DIFFUSES and the self-produced membrane GATES the
boundary flux, and show that the membrane — built by the metabolism it contains —
is what holds the individual together against dispersion. The autopoiesis of
containment, with precariousness extended to space.

studies.name: study-3-adaptive-chemotaxis
studies.description:
Place the precarious individual in an environment with a nutrient gradient and give
it a sensorimotor loop: sense the local nutrient, run-and-tumble (tumble less when
nutrient is rising), move. The nutrient feeds the metabolism that maintains the
membrane that keeps it alive. Show that a chemotactic agent climbs the gradient,
finds food, and survives — while a blind agent random-walks, starves, and dissolves.
This is where life becomes mind: the gradient is MEANINGFUL from the perspective of
the precarious identity (up-gradient = viable, down-gradient = dissolution). Value is
grounded in the cell's own viability, not assigned from outside — sense-making, and
agency in service of self-maintenance.

studies.name: study-4-growth-division
studies.description:
The precarious individual grows as its autopoietic loop runs and, past a size
threshold, DIVIDES into two daughters. The membrane is partitioned with noise so
daughters differ in size; a heritable trait is inherited with mutation so lineages
DIVERSIFY over generations — one individual becomes a population of non-identical
individuals. Division is itself precarious: a daughter that inherits too little
membrane to maintain itself dissolves — reproduction has a viability cost. This
heterogeneous population is the substrate on which study 5's selection can act.

studies.name: mesh-convergence
studies.description:
Run a uniform-refinement sequence and a residual-based adaptive (AMR)
sequence from the same coarse initial L-shaped mesh, fit the energy-norm-
error-vs-DOFs log-log slope for each, and confirm (a) the adaptive slope
is substantially steeper (closer to the optimal -1/2) than the uniform
slope (capped near -1/3), and (b) the adaptive mesh's cell density near
the re-entrant corner, relative to the far field, grows dramatically
relative to the initial mesh -- direct geometric evidence the estimator
is doing its job, not just producing a better number by coincidence.

studies.name: poisson-validation
studies.description:
For degree in {1, 2, 3} and a resolution sweep (mesh cells per side: 8,
16, 32, 64), solve -div(grad(u)) = f on the unit square with f and the
Dirichlet BC derived from u_exact = sin(pi*x)*sin(pi*y), compute each
point's L2 error against the true exact solution, and fit the log-log
convergence rate (slope of log error vs log h) per degree. Confirm P1's
rate lands near 2.0, P2's near 3.0, and P3's near 4.0 -- a rigorous
multi-order verification, not a single "error is small" checkbox.

studies.name: navier-stokes
studies.description:
Run the `vortex_street` composite (real dolfinx IPCS on a gmsh-generated,
cylinder-refined channel mesh) long enough to pass through the impulsive-
start transient into established periodic shedding, and verify (a) the
lift coefficient genuinely oscillates (not just noisy/flat), (b) the mean
drag coefficient sits in the neighborhood of the DFG 2D-2 benchmark's
Cd_max~=3.22-3.24, and (c) the shedding frequency's Strouhal number sits
in the neighborhood of the benchmark's St~=0.30.

studies.name: reaction-diffusion
studies.description:
Run the ``turing_patterns`` composite (2x DiffusionProcess ⊕
GrayScottReactionProcess) across three Gray-Scott parameter regimes and
confirm (a) the baseline regime's V field grows substantially more
spatially heterogeneous over the run (pattern EMERGES from a near-uniform
start), (b) the resulting pattern is bounded and structurally
non-trivial -- a finite fraction of the domain organizes into pattern
features, not the whole domain and not none of it -- and (c) different
(F, k) regimes produce measurably different pattern morphology (coverage
fraction), demonstrating the composed system is a genuine, tunable Turing
system, not a fixed numerical artifact.

studies.name: complex-geometry
studies.description:
Build the `porous_lattice` composite (a single `PorousFlowStep`: gmsh
pillar-lattice geometry construction -> dolfinx Taylor-Hood import ->
steady Stokes solve -> Darcy permeability) for a baseline porosity plus 3
porosity variants (sweeping `pillar_radius` at fixed 4x4 lattice density)
and verify (a) every solve is approximately divergence-free and exactly
no-slip on every pillar/wall boundary, and (b) the effective permeability
k_eff decreases monotonically as porosity decreases across all 4 points.

studies.name: transient-diffusion
studies.description:
Run the ``morphogen_gradient`` composite to steady state across THREE
decay-length regimes (D fixed, k swept: 1.0/2.0/4.0, giving
lambda=0.316/0.224/0.158) and confirm (a) each regime's steady profile is
genuinely exponential -- a fitted decay length within 10% of the analytic
lambda=sqrt(D/k), not just a qualitatively decreasing field -- (b) fields
stay bounded in [0, c0] (no accumulate-vs-overwrite blow-up, no unphysical
negative concentration), and (c) French-flag threshold crossings
(c=0.5*c0, c=0.1*c0) land within 10% of their analytic x-positions AND
shift monotonically inward as k increases -- demonstrating lambda's
control over the positional-information map is a real, tunable property
of the composed system, not a fixed artifact of one parameter set.

studies.name: moving-boundary
studies.description:
Run the `peristalsis` composite (`PeristalticWallProcess` ⊕
`PeristalticFlowProcess`, coupled through `mesh_displacement_y` /
`mesh_velocity_y` / `wall_time` shared stores -- see
`viva_fenics/processes/peristalsis.py`'s module docstring) at three
occlusion amplitudes and verify (a) the baseline's post-transient,
time-averaged net flow rate Q (`mean_ux`, the domain-averaged
x-velocity) is genuinely positive, and (b) Q increases monotonically
across the amplitude sweep.

composites.name: protometabolic_network
composites.description: A reusable protometabolic reaction-network module. A genuine libRoadRunner/Tellurium SBML ODE integration (needs tellurium) of an rTCA-fragment CSTR (pyruvate carboxylation + lumped autocatalytic rTCA turn + reductive branch) fed the og-01 reduced-carbon products under continuous feed+washout, with a networkx connectivity check on the species-reaction graph (needs networkx). Emergent: sustained carbon throughput, an autocatalytic motif (gain>1), and a connected reaction network.

composites.name: bioenergetic_internalization
composites.description: A reusable bioenergetic-internalization module (Module H). An evolutionary control loop (replicator dynamics, Sojo-2014 leaky-membrane fitness) under a declining external gradient: as the geochemical pmf collapses, an efficient-pump population internalizes gradient generation and persists, while a weak-pump control collapses (the Sojo constraint). catalyst_efficiency sets the arm. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not wrapped ALife).

composites.name: integrated_autonomy_world
composites.description: og-08's off-gradient test inside ONE persistent world assembled from the merged phases: the lineage lives on what real processes deliver — the external pmf tapped through its membrane leak and an internal store charged by the drive its live substrate pool sustains (an energy_coupling class, the STORAGE MODEL), organic carbon reaching it through a localization class (the TRANSPORT LAW) and the Phase-8 exchange rules at a boundary class's leakiness (the PERMEABILITY ASSUMPTION), the Phase-3 universe inside it catalysed by the mineral surface or by the machinery its heredity class holds (the INHERITANCE CLASS), upkeep priced by a MAINTENANCE LAW, and a population of individuals that divide and go extinct by structural rewrites. An AblationStep withdraws the gradient, the mineral access and the feed; pump (coupling_activity), importer (the ActiveUptakeRule) and heredity (attachment) are the three innovations; environment=generic is the og-adv reject control. Seven ledgers run beside the world and a structural-event log records every event. The vent endmembers are one Phase-1 posterior draw (vg-data integrated_autonomy).

composites.name: metabolite_exchange_community
composites.description: og-07's metacommunity rebuilt on real chemistry (Phase 8): N protocells in the agents map, each running the Phase-3 rule-generated reaction universe (libRoadRunner, eQuilibrator dG') masked to its lineage's catalyst repertoire (fixer: CO2 reduction + carboxylations; reducer: hydrogenations; condenser: aldol / formose; generalist: all), pointed at fixed cells of a pore whose background the Phase-4 localization class shapes species by species. A SpatialCouplingStep fires the exchange rules of a bigraphical reactive system every tick (uptake / secretion through size- and charge-dependent permeabilities, pore diffusion, feed / washout) and counts the firings; an EcologyReducerStep recomputes og-07's gate readouts from the agents (present vs produced functions); an EcologyElementLedgerProcess audits C / N / P over agents + field. coupling=private is the isolated counterfactual; model_proto_ecology=null_network the rewired control.

composites.name: heredity_lineage_comparison
composites.description: A reusable agent-based heredity-lineage comparison (Module K). Individuals carry a chemical phenotype inherited at fission into a real lineage tree, with a module-specific mechanism: template Eigen ratchet (Q=fidelity^length), compositional GARD split (length-independent, no template), a template-focused hybrid, or a severed non-heritable control. Emits population mean function, functional fraction, size, lineage depth and realized heritability. Reproduces the Eigen error catastrophe at the agent level AND shows compositional heredity escaping the length catastrophe — heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity template.

composites.name: mixed_amphiphile_protocell
composites.description: A reusable mixed-amphiphile protocell module (Module G). Coarse-grained vesicle self-assembly + permeability calibrated to Jordan 2019: mixed single-chain amphiphiles broaden the pH / salt / divalent stability window and form vesicles that retain chemistry while staying permeable to the gradient (individuality without isolation). mix_fraction≈0 / high salt / acidic pH give the controls. Coarse-grained reproduction (not wrapped MD).

composites.name: serpentinizing_vent_reactor
composites.description: A reusable alkaline-vent reactor module. Module A = genuine PHREEQC serpentinization (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat): olivine dissolution + serpentine/brucite/magnetite equilibrium gives dissolved H2 (reducing power), alkalinity, heat, pe, and a charge-balanced fluid. Module B = genuine FiPy finite-volume advection-diffusion-reaction column transporting those sources across the vent-ocean interface and setting outlet T/pH/porosity. PHREEQC conserves mass+charge and FiPy's FVM conserves flux, satisfying the og-00 contract invariants; the coupled model is driven by a real IPhreeqc speciation (needs phreeqpython) and a real FiPy FVM solve (needs fipy).

composites.name: serpentinizing_vent_reactor_reduced
composites.description: Reduced tuned-relaxation vent reactor (fallback / A-B comparison): Gaussian serpentinization source feeding a first-order relaxation box. Runs anywhere (no phreeqpython/fipy). NOT real geochemistry.

composites.name: electrochemical_carbon_fixation
composites.description: og-01's H2/pH-driven carbon fixation rebuilt as the Phase-2 electrochemical interface: the carbon-fixation mechanism is a model CLASS on the carbon_fixation face (model_carbon_fixation: empirical | butler_volmer | microkinetic). The empirical class is og-01's lab-calibrated gated kinetics driven by the real FiPy Nernst-Planck proton gradient + proton budget, with gradient_efficiency DERIVED from the wall's circuit (MineralConductivityProcess: conductivity, thickness, porosity vs the electrodes' charge-transfer resistance) instead of a knob. The butler_volmer class solves the vent wall as a galvanic cell each tick (Nernst half-cell potentials from the fluid redox state, Butler-Volmer kinetics scaled by catalyst activity / Ni fraction / T, Koutecky-Levich transport limits, the ohmic mineral + ionic path, the faradaic split over formate / acetate / pyruvate calibrated to the Altair-2025 current window and the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy). The microkinetic class (CatMAP/Cantera) builds here and runs under pixi. Every class publishes the thermodynamic / electrical / catalytic / transport loss fractions and a limitation code, and a ChargeLedgerProcess audits its electron balance (Kirchhoff residual, faradaic efficiency <= 1, current-voltage residual -> ledger/charge_ledger_ok). Free parameters are the vg-data package 'electrochemical_interface'.

composites.name: heredity_module_comparison
composites.description: A reusable heredity-module comparison (Module J). A genuine libRoadRunner/Tellurium SBML ODE integration (needs tellurium) of a quasispecies replicator (Eigen error threshold): a heredity module (RNA-like / peptide / low-fidelity / non-heritable) replicates a polymer with whole-sequence fidelity Q = fidelity^length; above the threshold the functional information is retained and inheritance pays, below it errors win. Compares modules head-to-head on lineage fitness.

composites.name: og_34_chemical_heredity_and_selection
composites.description: Gate D second half: selection on an inherited NETWORK COMPOSITION trait in a protocell population (⚑3 Option B; template copying = follow-on og-34a). Fitness is grounded in the real study-32/33 coupling (composition -> membrane retention [study-32 MD endpoints 0.333/0.661] -> standing pool -> division rate). inheritance=False is the matched no-inheritance null (daughters reset to the common composition). Reports parent-offspring fitness correlation + population composition shift; the vasas-2010 evolvability caveat is TESTED (does the population shift above the null?), not assumed. Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).

composites.name: og_12_energy_carrier_cycle
composites.description: Study 12: the energy currency as explicit chemistry. GeochemicalDriveProcess supplies an exergonic drive ΔG that activates a named thioester carrier only when it clears the high-energy bond; the carrier does useful work against an endergonic load and leaks by hydrolysis. A closed free-energy ledger (budget_residual ~ 0) credits useful coupled work only with no hidden energy inflow — replacing the abstract charged-pool currency.

composites.name: phosphorus_availability
composites.description: A reusable phosphorus-availability module. A genuine libRoadRunner/Tellurium SBML ODE integration (needs tellurium) of a P-speciation network (phosphate <-> polyphosphate <-> reactive-P with a precipitation/adsorption mineral sink) driven by a dissolved-phosphate supply, the og-03 thermal-gradient pore enrichment, and pore temperature. Emergent: the standing reactive-P pool, reactive-P production vs precipitation loss (net availability), and the precipitated fraction — does reactive P become available before phosphate precipitates?

composites.name: protocell_energetics
composites.description: A protocell's energy budget with the energy-coupling mechanism as a model CLASS on the energy_coupling face (model_energy_coupling: passive_gradient | h_na_gradient_leaky_membrane | thioester_acyl_phosphate | polyphosphate | fe_redox). The individual (radius, membrane permeability) sits between the external ion gradient (tapped only through its leak) and the chemical drive (H2/CO2 redox, or Fe(II) disproportionation for fe_redox; vg-data energy_currencies); coupling_activity moves it from passive to active. Publishes the per-individual power budget (external / internal / maintenance / leak / net power, the store, autonomy = internal / (internal + external)) audited by a FreeEnergyLedgerProcess. Coarse-grained deterministic kinetics (reproducible), not a wrapped engine.

composites.name: og_32_first_self_maintaining_protocell
composites.description: Full Gate C (Option B, MD-INFORMED not PMF-resolved): couples the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network (Gate-B pore) to an endogenous membrane whose permeability is INFORMED BY short Martini CG-MD of the amphiphile composition (bilayer thickness: DLPC/di-C12 2.325 nm vs DPPC/di-C16 2.870 nm). A solubility-diffusion relation (proposed_input) maps thickness->permeability->retention (thicker long-chain membrane retains more); retention lowers effective washout (k_wash*(1-retention)) at feeds held EQUAL to the ablation. membrane=False is the matched no-endogenous-membrane control (permeability open, retention 0). Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted). Full PMF-resolved permeability is Option A (study og-32a, budgeted follow-on).

composites.name: og_rtca_autocatalysis
composites.description: Curated MECHANISTIC reductive-TCA cycle (9 elementary steps incl. the citrate lyase branch; branched C6 intermediates citrate/isocitrate/cis-aconitate with eQuilibrator dG'; acetate as the acetyl-CoA surrogate; fumarate lumped) on the real libRoadRunner engine under vent CO2/H2 feed + washout. Its autocatalysis is topological (no coefficient-2 reaction), so the coefficient-gated autocatalytic_gain reads 0 by construction; feasibility + topology-specificity are graded by the coefficient-independent functional discriminator. matched_null swaps the degree-preserving null; carboxylation_drive_kj is a labelled stronger-reductant counterfactual (0 = real vent H2) that separates topology from thermodynamics.

composites.name: physical_reproduction
composites.description: og-growth-alt: a founder individual grows to a division threshold and divides by a _divide structural rewrite (matter + volume halved); the daughters grow and divide in turn, building a >=3-generation lineage in the agents map. A RewriteLedgerProcess audits that every division conserves matter (partition residual 0) and LineageStatsProcess reports the deepest generation + the total volume, which stays constant across divisions (the daughters' volumes sum to the mother's).

composites.name: og_36_stochastic_protocell_ecology
composites.description: Gate E ecology: does a cross-feeding protocell community out-produce the best single lineage at EQUAL feed, is the margin causally due to cross-feeding (knockout), and do low-count stochastic dynamics materially change it versus the deterministic mean-field? One StochasticProtocellEcologyProcess drives all arms: community (all seeded, cross-feeding on), monoculture (best single lineage, full feed, no partner), knockout (all seeded, cross-feeding off). deterministic=False is the exact Gillespie SSA (extinction breaks the ring); deterministic=True the matched mean-field. Option B (dependency-free SSA); GillesPy2/COBRApy = og-36a. Metabolism = sustained A1 community, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).

composites.name: og_33_chemically_coupled_growth_and_division
composites.description: Gate D first half: couples study 32's self-maintaining protocell to amphiphile-driven membrane growth and division at a MEASURED critical-geometry (reduced-volume) threshold (hanczyc/budin; ⚑2 Option B, NOT CG membrane mechanics - that is og-33a). Membrane area grows from the metabolism's productive flux; at the measured critical reduced volume the compartment divides (geometry, not an imposed rule). coupled=False is the growth-decoupled null (fixed amphiphile supply); imposed_division=True is the imposed-rule null. Daughters viable only if they resume study-32 self-maintenance. Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).

composites.name: og_35_chemical_energy_coupling
composites.description: Gate E energy coupling: does a specified thioester carrier cycle do endergonic work when the geochemical gradient DIPS, beating a matched gradient-only control, with a FULL closing energy ledger and no hidden inflow? carrier=True charges/discharges a stored carrier (buffered); carrier=False is the gradient-only null (direct drive->work, no store). Both see the same declining drive + load. Carrier chemistry = one specified thioester (Option B; acyl-phosphate / microkinetic = og-35a). Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).

composites.name: endogenous_boundary
composites.description: og-04-alt: a protocell boundary formed from the campaign's OWN chemistry. Acetate + formate condense to an amphiphile (AmphiphileSynthesisProcess); when it clears the critical aggregation concentration and the boundary face class (model_boundary: single_chain | mixed | thioester_aminothiol) reports a viable vesicle, a BoundaryFormationStep does an _add structural rewrite and a new individual appears in the agents map, matter seeded from the localized pool. Synthesis-ablated (k_synth=0) is the control: no amphiphile, no individual. A RewriteLedgerProcess audits that the _add conserves matter (rewrite_ok).

composites.name: og_28_prebiotic_reaction_atlas
composites.description: Study 28: build the versioned Prebiotic Reaction Atlas. Runs the real extract->validate pipeline over the measured-tier carbon-fixation seed and reports coverage + the zero-leakage guarantee: accepted_balance_violations == 0 while an unbalanced candidate is held back in proposed. Produces the shared data asset consumed by studies 29/30/31.

composites.name: og_17_amphiphile_chain_extension
composites.description: Study 17: endogenous amphiphiles by explicit chemistry. AmphiphileChainExtensionProcess elongates fatty acids 2 carbons at a time from the vent-carbon feed (acetate), with degradation and a length-dependent critical aggregation concentration — replacing the lumped acetate+formate condensation. Reports the chain-length distribution + whether the composition clears the CAC (aggregation_competent >= 1), the input og-31's Martini membrane run would assemble. No exogenous amphiphile feed; losses tracked.

composites.name: og_27_coupled_geochemical_reaction_interface
composites.description: Study 27: og-00's real serpentinizing vent made into an EVOLVING interface. geochemical_world (genuine PHREEQC speciation -> genuine FiPy transport) is augmented with MineralSurfaceDynamicsProcess: the reacted fluid's real carbonate saturation index drives precipitation/dissolution (a porosity delta that composes with FiPy's) and passivates the catalytic surface over time. Reports time- and space-resolved supply of H2/carbon/gradients/catalysis and the crossover time at which mineral evolution throttles it, with closed mass/charge/energy ledgers.

composites.name: thermophoretic_concentration
composites.description: A reusable thermophoretic-concentration module for the Baaske thermal trap. Module F = genuine FiPy finite-volume accumulation column (needs fipy): thermophoresis (Soret) + buoyant convection concentrate a dilute feed, enrichment exponential in pore length (>10^8 favorable, ~1 in controls). flow_velocity=0 / porosity=1 give the no-trap controls.

composites.name: open_chemical_network
composites.description: og-02's continuous-feed reactor rebuilt as the Phase-3 open chemical network: the reaction network is a model CLASS on the proto_metabolism face (model_proto_metabolism: curated_rtca | reaction_universe | null_network), all three integrated by the genuine libRoadRunner engine under the same Phase-1-posterior feed (CO2, H2, pyruvate), graded by one class-agnostic post-hoc detector (flux-carrying simple cycles with stoichiometric gain > 1) and audited by a NetworkLedgerProcess (exact element residual, integrated carbon balance, dissipation >= 0). The universe class is generated from Wolos-2020-style rules over linear C/H/O skeletons with eQuilibrator dG' (vg-data package reaction_universe); the null class is its degree-preserving, carbon-matched rewiring.

composites.name: og_31_membrane_benefit
composites.description: Partial Gate C: does an endogenous membrane pay for itself? Puts the sustained (A1, NOT autocatalytic) carbon-fixing network in the Gate-B concentrating pore and adds a REDUCED membrane coupling - retention reduces effective washout (k_wash*(1-retention)), finite access reduces effective feed crossing (feed*access) - with Jordan-2019-calibrated vent retention/access (0.905/0.997, grounded not tuned). membrane=False is the matched ablation (retention 0, access 1). Benefit = net carbon flux / persistence(membrane) > (ablation). NOT the MD-resolved PMF coupling (that is study 32 / viva-md-membrane = full Gate C).

composites.name: osmotic_growth_division
composites.description: A reusable osmotic growth-and-division module (metabolism → growth & division). An internal autocatalytic osmolyte source coupled to compartment osmotic physics: product accumulation → osmotic pressure (van 't Hoff) → solvent influx → volume growth → division at a size threshold. Membrane permeability sets the fate: too permeable starves (product leaks, no osmotic build-up), too impermeable lyses (pressure bursts the membrane), matched gives sustained growth → division. Units-typed, mass-conserving coarse-grained reproduction (not wrapped membrane MD).

composites.name: og_30_spatially_integrated_protometabolism
composites.description: Study 30: the reaction network operating IN A PORE. The real FiPy thermophoretic trap concentrates the precursor feed (enrichment_factor); the enriched pore-local feed drives open_chemical_network's real reaction universe. concentrating=False runs the matched nonconcentrating control (feed at base, everything else equal) so the decision test — productive flux in the pore exceeds the control — is a direct comparison. Reports co-localization, spatial reaction flux, residence, persistence.

composites.name: hydrothermal_carbon_fixation
composites.description: A reusable H2/pH-driven carbon-fixation module. Module C = genuine FiPy finite-volume Nernst-Planck pH-gradient electrochemistry (pmf, current density; needs fipy). Module D = genuine eQuilibrator ΔG' feasibility gate (needs equilibrator_api) + lab-calibrated (Preiner/Hudson) mineral-catalyzed CO2 reduction to formate/acetate/pyruvate. gradient_efficiency=1.0 is the favorable arm; ~0.1 is the Tutolo-2026 in-situ collapse. catalyst_active/h2=0 give the controls.

composites.name: og_37_progressive_independence
composites.description: Gate E progressive independence: withdraw each environmental support ONE AT A TIME and ask which the lineage can internalize (persist via an innovation) vs which are hard dependencies. Reuses the validated og-08 off-gradient budget (OffGradientPersistenceProcess + EnvironmentalRelaxationProcess) verbatim — no invented terms — but relaxes a single channel at a time (others held full) instead of og-08's joint all-at-once relaxation, so a matched per-support ablation (rescuing innovation off -> fail) attributes each support to its internalizing innovation (gradient->pump, mineral/feed->importer, all gated by heredity). Channels: gradient (pH/pmf drive), mineral_access (mineral catalysis), feed (H2+CO2+organics LUMPED — per-feedstock split + temperature-Arrhenius = og-37a). Coarse budget abstraction = an affordability/attribution profile, NOT a demonstrated escape; heredity = irreducible substrate. Terminal (consumes 34/35/36, extends nothing).

composites.name: proto_energetics
composites.description: A transferable energy currency before modern pumping (pre-og-05). An exergonic geochemical drive charges a carrier pool (thioester / acyl-phosphate class) that is discharged for endergonic work under load and bled by hydrolysis, all tracked in a conserved free-energy ledger (input = work + stored + dissipated). Tests whether the system captures environmental free energy into a transferable store, and what fraction becomes stored usable work. drive_free_energy / coupling_efficiency set the arm; coupling->0 or drive below the carrier bond collapses the currency (ablations). Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not a wrapped engine).

composites.name: og_29_endogenous_autocatalysis
composites.description: Study 29: is vent-fed chemistry self-amplifying? Reuses open_chemical_network's real reaction-universe engine + autocatalysis detector, but feeds the network from the ENDOGENOUS 27->29 supply (H2 + inorganic carbon from the evolving geochemical interface) rather than a prescribed feed. matched_null swaps the degree-preserving null on the same supply for the Gate A comparison (chemical input fluxes held equal). Reports amplification (autocatalytic_gain), net carbon fixation, intermediate turnover and the critical dilution (k_wash) at which the loop washes out.

composites.name: cross_feeding_metacommunity
composites.description: A reusable cross-feeding metacommunity module (Module L). N connected compartments, each a coarse-grained capability vector over a protometabolic function set, evolving under cross-feeding (byproduct of one feeds the next capability in a neighbour), horizontal transfer, and parasite/cooperator roles. Connected heterogeneous populations develop capability redundancy (robustness) and a collective repertoire single compartments do not; the emergent set's overlap with the anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA reconstruction is reported as a far-end boundary, not a target. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not wrapped ALife).

composites.name: geochemical_world
composites.description: og-00's real serpentinizing vent (genuine PHREEQC peridotite speciation feeding a genuine FiPy finite-volume advection-diffusion solve) rebuilt as the Phase-1 geochemical world: both mechanisms are selected through typed faces (model_serpentinization: phreeqc | reduced; model_spatial_transport: fipy convecting | fipy_uniform_upflow | fenics), so the model CLASS is a categorical sweep axis beside the physical parameters, and a ConservationLedgerProcess audits integrated sources against accumulated pools, charge balance, flux divergence and heat directionality (ledger/ledger_ok). The free parameters are the vg-data package 'vent_environment' (value-or-distribution, units, context, source, provenance class), which the environmental-calibration ensemble samples.

composites.name: reduced_nitrogen_reactor
composites.description: A reusable FeS-mediated reduced-nitrogen module. The real ReducedNitrogenProductionProcess reduces NO3-/NO2- to NH4+ on an Fe/Ni/S catalyst (H2-dependent, temperature-windowed), adds a minor abiotic N2-fixation source, and draws ammonium into amino-acid precursors by reductive amination at a rate set by the carbon-fixation demand. Tracks the C:N supply ratio (carbon demand / reduced-N production) to test whether reduced nitrogen keeps pace with reduced carbon. fes_activity=0 / h2=0 are the no-mineral / no-reductant controls.

composites.name: off_gradient_persistence
composites.description: A reusable off-gradient-persistence module (Module M). A lineage's co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget under relaxing geological support (external gradient, mineral access, feed all declining over the run), with three toggleable innovations: internal energy conversion (has_pump), active resource import (has_importer) and information maintenance (has_heredity). Because the budget is co-limited the innovation set is irreducible — as support -> 0 only the full set keeps net budget above the survival floor, so a knockout sweep identifies {pump, importer, heredity} as the minimum robust set for autonomy. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not a wrapped ALife engine).

composites.name: competing_heredity
composites.description: og-06's heredity lineage rebuilt as the Phase-7 competing-heredity composite: the inheritance mechanism is a model CLASS on the heredity face (model_heredity: compositional | network | peptide | rna_like | hybrid | mineral_state), every class an exact Gillespie lineage of protocell-scale individuals (tens of heritable molecules each) drawing integer precursors and energy quanta from the SAME chemostat-fed pools and energy store. HeredityAttachmentStep attaches heredity only when the precursor budget, the energy budget and the class's expected copy fidelity (Eigen Q >= 1/sigma) allow it — before that, daughters re-form their heritable material de novo (the non-heritable control). InformationLedgerProcess prices the realised parent-offspring mutual information per joule and per precursor and audits the energy store exactly.

composites.name: og_31_protometabolism_to_amphiphiles
composites.description: Study 31: do amphiphiles assemble into a membrane? Drives real Martini 3 CG MD (viva-openmm) on a generated POPE bilayer; minimize+NVT relaxes the clashy initial placement into a bound bilayer so the potential energy settles negative — the membrane-cohesion / assembly signal. Reports PE/KE (cohesion), static area-per-lipid and lipid count. Charged-intermediate permeability (PMF) is the documented follow-up.

composites.name: spatial_transport_trap
composites.description: og-03 thermophoretic trap behind the swappable spatial_transport face. The live, default solver is a genuine 1-D FiPy finite-volume accumulation column (model_spatial_transport='fipy', runs anywhere, backs every canonical run). The face also swaps in the MERGED dolfinx FEM solver with a Soret-drift weak-form term (model_spatial_transport='fenics') — a real high-fidelity cross-check, run on demand under viva-fenics's pixi env (dolfinx is conda-only, so in the uv venv 'fenics' raises a clear 'run under pixi' error). The FiPy↔FEniCS head-to-head on this trap was run that way and shows the two agree up to Pe_acc≈4 and diverge to ~5.6 decades by Pe_acc≈18, so the >1e6-fold column is a reduced-model extrapolation the resolved FEM does not confirm. assert_face is enforced at build. Same pore physics, FiPy grades and FEniCS cross-checks (plan 4.5).

composites.name: spatial_transport_vent
composites.description: og-00 vent reactor transport behind the swappable spatial_transport face. The live, default solver is a genuine 2-D FiPy finite-volume advection-diffusion FVM (model_spatial_transport='fipy', backs every canonical run); the face swaps in the MERGED dolfinx FEM advection-diffusion solver (model_spatial_transport='fenics') — a real high-fidelity cross-check run on demand under viva-fenics's pixi env (dolfinx conda-only, so 'fenics' raises 'run under pixi' in the uv venv). The FiPy↔FEniCS head-to-head on this vent agrees to within 0.30% outlet T (identical pH, flux conserved ~1e-15), so the habitability result is solver-robust. Prescribed serpentinization drivers (H2/alkalinity/heat) isolate the transport solver; assert_face enforced at build. Same world, FiPy grades and FEniCS cross-checks (plan 4.5).

studies.description:
Build the integrated composite, derive the process↔cell-variable wiring matrix

confirm it composes and stays viable.

steady-state run's protein_counts, pack the cell, and compare per-category
species counts and occupancy to the s01 baseline.

studies.name: fig3-expression
studies.description:
Run the fig3_expression composite (transcription + translation + rna_decay +
protein_decay) for one hour at the default 1 s interval, gather per-gene mRNA
and protein counts, and read out mean mRNA per gene, final total protein, the
protein-to-mRNA ratio, and the fraction of panel genes expressed.

studies.name: fig5-energy
studies.description:
Run the fig5_energy composite for one hour (metabolism/mass at 60 s,
expression at 1 s) to time-average ATP/GTP production, then step the
transcription and translation processes directly for one hour to tally their
NTP/GTP consumption, and compute the modeled energy shares and the ATP:GTP
synthesis ratio.

studies.name: fig2-growth
studies.description:
Run the fig2_growth composite (metabolism + mass) for one cell cycle, fit the
exponential growth rate to recover the doubling time, confirm mass doubles over
the cycle, and read out the dry-mass composition at division.

studies.name: fig7-kinetic-parameters
studies.description:
Programmatically identify a growth-limiting reaction in the iPS189 network
(one whose bound binds when throttled yet whose growth recovers to the
wild-type plateau before the top of the sweep), sweep its flux bound over
np.logspace(-2, 1, 16) with MetabolismFbaReproductionProcess, and read out
whether the kcat→growth curve is monotonic, saturating, and has a clear
dynamic range.

studies.name: fig4-cell-cycle
studies.description:
Simulate a population of ~128 single cells with random birth DnaA and dNTP
levels by stepping the ReplicationReproductionProcess directly, recover the
three Fig 4 single-cell correlations, and render a representative single-cell
dynamics trajectory through the fig4_cell_cycle composite.

studies.name: fig6-gene-essentiality
studies.description:
For every metabolic gene with a reference call, run a single-gene FBA knockout
via MetabolismFbaReproductionProcess, call it essential when growth_fraction
drops below 0.05, cross-tabulate against the reference calls into a 2x2
confusion matrix, and score accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Also run
the fig6_gene_essentiality composite once for a representative essential gene
(MG_023) to record a canonical baseline and confirm growth collapses.

studies.name: parca-parameter-fitting
studies.description: Run the mycoplasma_parca composite: compute the fitted per-gene panel from the decoded knowledge base, report the fit summary (gene count, mRNA/rRNA half-lives, median synthesis rate), the metabolic demand it implies, and the expression↔metabolism feasibility closure.

of species at their WC-MG abundances with a single supercoiled chromosome seeded
from the S2 genome.

subsets at Δt = 0.005, and ε is the RMS over space and time of (trial mean − E[U]),

studies.name: single-channel-fokker-planck
studies.description:
Dimensionless model: ∂τρ = d·∂²ₓρ + a·δ(x)·ξ − ρ. The channel opens at αβ(ρ(0) + 1) and closes
at α; it starts closed, with ρ = 0.

- **Test 3:** α = β = 1, a = 24, d = 10⁴, 3D cube of side 1 (Δx = 0.1, channel at the centre),
  Δτ = 0.002.
  - Compared: p(ρ̄) at τ = 30.
  - Reference: Eq 4, solved in time and checked against its exact steady state.
  - Ensembles: 10,000 co-sim trials, and the same on native VCell.
- **Test 4:** α = 10, β = 1, a = 20/3, d = 1, two cells with Δx = 2, Δτ = 10⁻⁴.
  - Compared: p(ρᵢ) at τ = 1.
  - Reference: the S2-Text master equation (Eq T2.1) at Δρ = 2.5, 1.2 and 0.6 × 10⁻³, extrapolated
    to Δρ → 0.
  - Ensembles: 12,500 trials.
- **Test 5:** α = 20, β = 0.5, a = 20, d = 50, three cells.
  - Reference: four Δρ, extrapolated as in the paper.
  - Ensembles: 12,500 trials at Δτ = 10⁻⁴.

Densities are 20-bin histograms on [0, ρ_max(i)] (40 bins on [0, 24] for Test 3), compared with the
reference averaged over the same bins. Reported: the relative L2 (RMS over bins / reference
maximum), the absolute L2, and the reduced χ² against multinomial sampling noise.

Generates a .cu model, compiles it with nvcc against a ya||a checkout, and round-trips agent state through the compiled binary each step. On a CPU/macOS host this raises YallaCudaUnavailable — use yalla-springs-demo (reproduction) instead.

composites.name: monolayer_liftoff
composites.description: 3D monolayer "lift-off": a flat epithelial sheet is extruded into a polyhedral monolayer (apical surface at z=0, basal at z=-1) and a high line tension is placed on the apical-surface edges only — a purse-string that, against cell volume elasticity and face area/contractility, buckles the apical surface out of plane (the first step of lumen / dome morphogenesis). Pure mechanics, no COPASI coupling. Settings from T. Rahman's monolayer_liftoff notebook.

composites.name: jamming
composites.description: Flat sheet with stochastic line tension plus a CellJamming event that, at a trigger time, ramps preferred perimeter toward a jammed (rigid) regime.

composites.name: gillespie
composites.description: Intestinal-crypt model on a cylindrical vessel: the EulerSolver handles mechanics while a Gillespie process stochastically fires cell-type transitions (stem -> progenitor -> enterocyte/goblet, extrusion) under Wnt- and density-dependent regulation.

composites.name: regulation
composites.description: Cylinder sheet with a CellDivisions process that randomly triggers cell division (Poisson rate) above a critical area, driving tissue growth.

composites.name: base_solver
composites.description: Baseline tyssue vertex model on a cylindrical (vessel) sheet, integrated with the generalized Euler solver. No behaviors — pure mechanical relaxation.

composites.name: stochastic
composites.description: Flat (square) sheet with Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stochastic line-tension fluctuations on every edge, producing jittery cell-shape dynamics / migration.

composites.name: HRA colon surface (3D)
composites.description: A 3D epithelial sheet draped over the real Human Reference Atlas large-intestine reference organ surface — the full-resolution organ mesh subdivided into ~15k small, uniform cells so each cell is tiny relative to the whole organ, with cells labelled by the crypt's ASCT+B cell-type proportions. Orbit to inspect the anatomy; this is a real organ shape, not a generated mesh.

composites.name: anisotropic
composites.description: Flat sheet with an AnisotropicTension step that biases line tension along a chosen axis, driving oriented (anisotropic) tissue elongation.

composites.name: epithelium_2d
composites.description: Baseline flat (square) 2D sheet epithelium — pure mechanical relaxation.

composites.name: HRA intestinal crypt (2D)
composites.description: A single intestinal crypt of Lieberkühn, initialized straight from the Human Reference Atlas 2D-FTU illustration — the real cell layout coloured by real HRA cell type. Note the zonation: stem + neuroendocrine cells at the narrow base, absorptive and goblet cells up the column, tuft cells near the flared villus top.

composites.name: gradient
composites.description: Flat sheet with stochastic line tension and a ParameterGradient step that imposes a linear spatial gradient of preferred perimeter along x.

studies.name: lumen-liftoff
studies.description: Build the 3D monolayer lift-off composite (a flat sheet extruded into a polyhedral monolayer with an apical-edge "purse-string" line tension) and demonstrate, through 3D animation, a side profile, and morphology time-series, that the apical surface deforms out of plane against cell-volume elasticity.
